$semantics.rounding: Every instruction below that says 'rounded' means round half away from zero (half-up): 745.5 becomes 746, -745.5 becomes -746. Do not use banker's rounding. Round only where an instruction says to; carry full precision everywhere else.
$semantics.chargeable_weight: max(actual_kg, (l*w*h)/volumetric_divisor), then rounded UP to the nearest multiple of 0.5 kg. A value already on a multiple of 0.5 is unchanged: 6.0 stays 6.0, 6.01 becomes 6.5.
$semantics.weight_breaks: Select the first break whose up_to_kg is >= chargeable weight (null = no upper bound). If the break has 'flat', that is the base. Otherwise base = break.base + ceil(chargeable - break.from_kg) * break.per_kg. Boundaries are inclusive of the break below: chargeable of exactly 5.0 selects the up_to_kg 5 break, not the 5-to-20 break.
$semantics.fuel_surcharge: pct of base, rounded, then capped at cap_minor if cap_minor is present. Round before capping.
$semantics.oversize: flat surcharge if any single dimension exceeds oversize_over_cm. Strictly greater than: exactly 120 is not oversize.
$semantics.remote_area: flat surcharge if the destination postcode starts with any listed prefix. Compare case-insensitively with all whitespace removed from the postcode.
$semantics.handling_fee: charged once per quote request. Waived entirely for merchants whose account tier is in waived_for_tiers.
$semantics.transit: transit_business_days, counted Mon-Fri excluding origin-country holidays. Day 1 is the first business day strictly AFTER the quote date in the origin timezone; the quote date itself is never counted, whether or not it is a business day. If the quote is requested at or after cutoff_local in the origin location's timezone, add 1 to transit_business_days before counting.
$semantics.tax: tax_pct applied to (base + all surcharges, including the handling fee), rounded
$semantics.holidays: The holidays block is this contract's non-operating calendar and is authoritative. Do not supplement it with public holiday data. A date in a year not listed has no holidays.
